correctness.rationale: With alpha_1=1 and spectrum exactly {mu,1}, the first residual is (I-A)r_0=(1-mu)P_mu r_0, so the top eigenspace is annihilated. In the nontrivial branch all later residuals remain in the mu-eigenspace. If q_k is in [0,1-mu], then 1-mu(1+q_k) is at least (1-mu)^2>0, so the norm ratio is exactly q_{k+1}=1-mu-mu q_k and remains in the invariant interval. Solving this affine recurrence gives the stated fixed point, alternating error law, and convergence of alpha to 2/(1+mu), the minimax fixed GD step.
risks: The exact scalar reduction fails once interior eigenvalues survive the first step or the top eigenvalue is not normalized exactly to one.
